name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Deliver approved goals to fully release-ready PRs or verified production with zero scoped leftovers.

interface.shortDescription: Reach PR_READY or SHIPPED in one task
interface.longDescription: Keeps the invoking task accountable and resumable until either an open candidate is fully production-release-ready or the exact candidate is proven live in production with zero scoped leftovers. Release, promote, and deploy normalize to ship; blockers remain resumable checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <approved-plan-path>. Use ship for complete production delivery. Keep this task accountable through waits and repairs; succeed only as PR_READY or SHIPPED with zero scoped leftovers.
